text_block_list.text:
With the Satsuki Sho behind us, the days 
continued with training more focused and 
rigorous than usual in preparation for the 
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew, h-haah...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So tough~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, my form was a total mess in the 
second half. I really don't have enough 
stamina at all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Can I add more stamina-focused training? I 
need to get more running in during my own 
practice too...

The notepad she opened was filled to the 
brim with meticulously detailed training 
menus.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on, everyone does at least this 
much. If anything, I really need to work 
way harder~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The Nippon Derby only happens once in a 
lifetime. I want to make sure I'm in peak 
condition!

And then one day, several reporters came 
to interview Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Miss Bourbon's had a lot of them lately. 
She's looking sharper and sharper, so I 
guess that makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I have to get some good stories out of 
Bourbon-san today, no matter what...

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...I wish I could write an interesting 
article too. Though I'm sure it'll end up 
the same this time... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...? I wonder what's up. Being a reporter 
must be really tough, huh?

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...! So there's an Umamusume you 
have your eye on for the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. She's normally the modest, quiet 
type, but during the Satsuki Sho, I caught 
a glimpse of her sheer intimidation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Since then, her rapid growth has been 
clearly visible in her training sessions 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I have determined they 
could be a "formidable rival" in the 
Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: T-Thank you so much! Um, next is...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! What is that Umamusume's name?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It's "Rice Shower."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No way, to think that Bourbon-san was 
conscious of Rice-san too...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come to think of it, I actually 
interviewed Rice recently!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I bumped into Rice-san by chance 
while taking a walk, but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Rice-san! What a coincidence~. Best of 
luck in the upcoming Derby!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: L-Likewise...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Isn't your sole coming off? 
Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right...! Maybe I've been 
running too much. I've gotta change them.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Until your shoes are worn to tatters! 
Wow, you really are working so hard...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I could feel your 
fighting spirit crackling even in the 
Satsuki Sho! The race was amazing, too—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You really think so? I still feel like I 
can't catch up at all...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Catch up... Ah, are you talking about 
Bourbon-san?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh!? How did you know about that...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, the truth is, in the underground 
passage at the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-So you saw that... I see...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for peeking! But your 
feelings were just so passionate, 
Rice-san, that it made me really want to 
cheer you on!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I can certainly understand why you'd look 
up to Miss Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whenever Miss Bourbon runs, the stands 
just light up! She's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-Really...!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Miss Bourbon is strong, cool, and an 
amazing Umamusume who can make everyone 
smile so, so much...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why Rice wants to become an 
Umamusume like Bourbon-san someday, 
someday...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I... I just thought it'd be nice if I 
could be...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Or so the story I overheard goes~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Bourbon-san for inspiring such feelings, 
and Rice-san for growing stronger through 
Bourbon-san's presence— I think you're 
both wonderful~!"

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: U-Umm, about that story...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me, could you tell me more 
about that, please?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah!? O-of course I will!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea you felt that way...! This 
is going to make for an eye-catching 
article!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. It might be a good idea to ask 
one of the tipsters who they think will 
win.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mmhâ¦â¦ "Which one"?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Actually, higher-ups told me to just treat 
the other girls as background 
characters... Because what people will 
read is the article on Mihono Bourbon, 
after all.

He seems so absorbed in his work that he 
hasn't noticed the Umamusume in front of 
him is actually a runner in the Japan 
Derby.
choice_data_list:
(As her trainer, I can't just stay 
silent—)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hold on just a moment!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I get that Bourbon-san and Rice-san are so 
amazing that the other Umamusume get 
overshadowed, but still!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I know that's what people are expecting 
too, but still—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Still, how should I put it... it's not 
like the other girls have zero chance of 
winning, right?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: ...? Ah, oh!! Matikanetannhauser! ...san!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I am so terribly sorry! I just didn't 
notice...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, don't worry about it! I mean, I'm 
plain, I'm ordinary! There's nothing 
special about me at all!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, but even so... talking about the 
possibility of winning is another matter 
entirely.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Because even for me, anything less than 
1st place is completely useless!"

Though her gentle aura remained the same 
as always, there was unmistakable passion 
behind her words.

A few hours later. I spotted the reporter 
with round glasses looking somewhat deeply 
moved.

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...I see, even if it's nothing 
'special'...

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm not "special," I still "want 
to win"... That's enough for me...

The Nippon Derby is right around the 
corner.
